headline: Site walk to examine existing conditions for proposed Phase V subdivision of Tax Map 14 Lot 15.
summary: The site walk will look at existing conditions on the land for the proposed Phase V subdivision. The land is Tax Map 14 Lot 15.
items: Site walk to examine existing conditions for proposed Phase V subdivision of Tax Map 14 Lot 15
plain_text:
"Derry, New Hampshire's Place to Be" 
14 Manning Street, Derry, New Hampshire 03038 ▪ p.603.432.6100  f.603.432.6131 
 
 
NOTICE OF SITE WALK 
 
The Conservation Commission for the Town of Derry will hold a site walk on Monday, 
November 2, 2026, beginning at 3:00pm at 22.5 Overledge Drive. The purpose of this site walk 
is to examine existing conditions relative to the proposed Phase V subdivision of Tax Map 14 
Lot 15. 
 
POSTED: October 16, 2026
